lines.en: : Alright, ladies! Listen up!
: I know y’all look at me like some kinda loser that knowns nothin’ ‘bout anythin’, but I’m here today to tell ya that I do know somethin’! And that somethin’ is sports!
: Apologies for interrupting, but I don’t think any of us need reminding that your expertise lies in-
: Personal foul — roughing the speaker! Number six! Fifteen-yard penalty! First down, Miku!
: ...What?
: It means shut the heck up while I’m tryin’ to give my motivational speech! I don’t care if ‘yer my roommate or not! I got trainin’ to do!
: Just let her continue, Makoto. We all showed up because we trust Miku to lead us to victory in this year's sports-day-slash-dorm-wars contest.
: The full title is actually: Super Mega Ultimate Sports-Day Dorm Wars: No Boys Allowed ~ The Extremely Awesome and Only Kind of Sad Special Event for Bonding and Battling.
: Was the “No Boys Allowed” part really necessary to add? Because I really don’t think Sensei was planning on showing up this year even if he were invited.
: I think that’s...why we added the “kind of sad” part...but I agree that...we should make the title a little shorter...
: The title ain’t important right now! All that matters is preparin’ for the SMUS-DDW:NBA ~ TEAaOKoSSEfBaB so we ain’t blindsided by any plannin’ those second floor gals are doin’!
: Is it just me or does the acronym make it even harder to remember?
: It’s just you. I can remember SMUS-DDW:NBA ~ TEAaOKoSSEfBaB just fine.
: Thank you, Ayane! But again, the name ain’t important right now!
: The unfortunate truth is we’ve always had an advantage when it comes to these Dorm Wars thingies since ours is the floor that loves Sensei the most!
: Now that he’s stripped outta the competition entirely, we’ve gotta figure out a way to compensate! And that ain’t gonna be easy when they’ve got girls like Touka and Noriko up there!
: Are either of those two athletic? Because I’ve never seen either one of them do anything to prove that at any point.

: Touka’s always talkin’ about how she wants to show us her skills when it comes to that stuff. And if there’s anythin’ I know about vegans like Noriko, it’s that they’ve got super powers and can fly and stuff.
: Noriko’s a vegetarian, actually. She’s not vegan.
: Damn. So she probably just has super-speed instead.
: If anything, I think Tsuneyo is the one we’re going to have to worry about. She’s kind of...comically strong.
: Doesn’t...Kirin have experience with sports too?...
: I wouldn’t be surprised if dorm seven was above-average in that field as well. Uta’s great when it comes to archery and I’m pretty sure Io is into baseball.
: And all that’s exactly why we’ve gotta practice!

: We’ve still got no clue what sortsa contests we’ll be havin’ and what kinda games we’ll be playin’, so we’ve gotta prepare for anythin’ and everythin’ so we can have strategies in place and not look bad!
: I’m surprised to see your competitive spirit this ignited, Miku. Normally, that’s my thing. And we don’t even know this year’s prize yet, so there’s no way that’s what lit this fire.
: It ain’t the prize that matters, Makoto. It’s the glory of the braggin’ rights. And I ain’t just sayin’ that since only like one instance of the Dorm Wars has actually had a real prize.
: Shh...I thought we agreed that we were going to stop bringing that up?
: We are! So instead of focusin’ on the past, let’s start figurin’ out where to go in the future!
: Futaba! Tell me some of ‘yer strengths!
: Me?
: Yes, you! There’s gotta be somethin’ you’re good at when it comes to sports!
: Can I pass? I’ve never really been an athletic person.
: Part’a bein’ an athlete is mental too! Just think’a baseball! That game’s like 90%% mental and 5%% physical, with the other 10%% bein’ luck!
: Five...ten...
: Then...I guess...I’m okay when it comes to problem-solving? Maybe? So long as the problem...isn’t about me...I think...
: Like, I don’t want to say I’m creative, but-
: Yeah, yeah, yeah! Good enough!
: If you’re good at problem solving, you might make a good coach! And you like reading, don’t ya?! Which means ya could get familiar with the rules of stuff super quick! Maybe!

: So, since we ain’t got any idea what we’ll be playin’ yet, why don’t ya head on over to the library after our meeting today and take out a book on every sport ever?! That’ll be sure to give us an advantage.
: E...Every sport?....
: I don’t think Miku understands how quickly the average person reads, Futaba. I’ll help you look for relevant materials once we’re done here.
: Sana! You next! What are you good at?
: No need to answer! I already know you’re gonna say video games! Which means your hand-eye coordination is probably better than a lot of the other girls!
: I...I mean...um...maybe? But I...get tired really easily and...
: Drink a Monster! Maybe two! Do whatever ya gotta do to amp those energy levels up, cause you’ll be our secret weapon once sports day rolls around! Got it?!
: N-No?!?! Why do I have to be the secret weapon?! I couldn’t even answer my own question!
: Maybe we’ll get lucky and there will be some sort of...video-game based competition?
: For sports day?! I doubt it, coach! We’ve gotta prepare for a full day’s worth of sweatin’ and...well, sports! And anythin’ else that starts with an S! Spaghetti maybe?
: What about me, Miku? I’m good at all sorts of stuff.
: Which means you’ll be our ringer! Same as me. And if we’re able to compete in more than one thing, me and you’ll be the ones to make the second floor’s life a living hell. Understood?!
: Got it! But also, please reconsider making Sana the secret weapon. I really don’t think she’s built for things like this.
: I ain’t reconsiderin’ nothin’, Ayane! This ain’t ‘yer grandma’s sports-day! This is the contest to end all contests! And by George, we’re gonna win this one for the boys back home!
: As much as I agree, I thought your whole thing was that sports are great for reasons outside of the winning part?
: That was before the boys came back home, Makoto! Now, we’ve gotta win this for them!
: What boys? All the boys are still in space. Apart from my dad, at least.
: You know...the boys! The ones back home!
: The boys on the docks! The boys are back in town! You know! The boys!
: Forget Makoto! The point is, we’ve all got a role to play!
: Tom Brady says that the true competitors are the ones who always play to win. And the last thing we need is those people livin’ above us thinkin’ they’re higher up the ladder than we are!
: That’s- oh, it’s not even worth it.
: You’ve got that right, boobzilla! Now, everybody stand up tall and pay attention while I give ya the rundown of every single sport we might be playin’ for sports-day! You too, Sana!
: Huh?...What?...Where am I?...
: The first sport we’re gonna talk about is curling. Ya see, it all starts with a broom-
: Okay. Hit the showers, everybody. And thank you for being the ones who actually showed up. Futaba, you can have a head start so Miku can’t prey upon you again.
: Hey! That’s a deleted scene now, damn it! And don’t go puttin’ an end to my meeting without askin’ me first!
: Then, would you like to do the honors? Because class is already done for the day and you told everyone this would only take ten minutes.
: Ten minutes...ten hours...what’s the difference?
: That would be 590 minutes.
: You think you’re so damn smart, don’t ya?
: Do you want the honors or not? Because we can’t keep them here all day.
: As a matter of fact, I would. Thank you.
: Let this be a lesson to all of ya! If ‘yer gonna give a speech, make sure ya don’t bring Makoto along to listen to it!
: Meeting adjourned! But don’t forget we’ve got another-
: Heh?
: The heck you tryin’ to hold my hand for? We both like boys.
: Miku, you have phonophobia. Do you really think I’m going to let you blow a whistle and send yourself into shock?
: Oh, right. Good call.
: Anyway! Hit the showers, girls! Me and Makoto’ll be there once we clean up our balls!
: She means our sports balls.
: We’ll support you no matter what kind of balls you have, Makoto.
: Why do I feel like I’ve had this conversation before?
: So...you’re really into the Dorm Wars this year, aren’t you?
: Huh? Course I am. We’re combinin’ two of my favorite things — sports and war. Just kinda sucks that Sensei won’t be involved this time.
: I’m sure he’ll be back next year. Or the year after. There’s only so much time he can spend moping around now that life is a constantly repeating-
: Wonder what he’s up to right now? Haven’t seen him since karaoke the other night.
: Karaoke?
: Yeah. Remember when I-
: Oh god, I just remembered what happened right before that.
: Shhh...no you don’t. That was all in your head, Miku. You never saw anything at all. And if you did, it definitely wasn’t me you saw doing it. Now, what’s this about karaoke?
: Oh, sorry. Me and Sensei bumped into Karin when we were walkin’ around and the three of us wound up goin’ to that karaoke place near the school.
: Since when are you into karaoke? You haven’t expressed any interest in that for as long as I’ve known you.
: Iduno, figured I’d try somethin’ new for once. Didn’t amount to much though since I forgot I already made plans with Io and Uta and had to bail before even tryin’ to sing a song.
: Huh...
: Somethin’ felt kinda off, though. Sensei started bein’ weird as soon as I brought up the idea. Didn’t realize he was that self-conscious.
: Guess I don’t know as much about him as you, though. For all I know, you two have been knockin’ boots in that same place for the past-
: Wait! That’s it, ain’t it! He felt weird ‘cause I was bringin’ him to-
: Shh. Keep your voice down.
: He felt weird ‘cause I was bringin’ him to your secret sex lounge and he ain’t done that with me and Karin yet.
: Uhh...no. I don’t think that’s it. I’ve only been there with him on one occasion and I can promise you it was definitely not sexual. Just weird.
: Picturin’ you two singin’ together is definitely weird, so yeah. I can see that.
: No, I just mean there might be other reasons why he’s...uncomfortable there. It just doesn’t make much sense to me yet, so I’m not sure if I can explain it well enough for you to understand.
: But regardless, I’m sure he’ll get over his hump sure enough.
: Well, that’s good. ‘Cause I know we’ve got some humpin’ we wanna do as well.
: I really don’t like this openly sexual side of you. You’re starting to remind me of my mom.
: Ain’t nothin’ wrong with that. Maki’s great. And thanks to her, I aint back-alley medicated no more. Plus, I’m learnin’ to actually talk about stuff, too. And you’ve wanted me to do that forever.
: How’s that going, by the way? We haven’t really talked about it lately.
: Fine, I guess. Haven’t really gotten to the tough parts yet. But you said it took a little while for you to get there too, didn’t it?
: It did, yeah...but I’m also a lot more open as a person than you’ve ever been.
: Are ya? Cause apart from this one thing, I sure don’t think so. You’ve been keepin’ your sadness a secret for as long as I’ve known ya.
: I’m glad, though. Cause lately, you’ve felt a lot...different. Happier, maybe?
: I don’t really know. Maybe I’m wrong and ya ain’t happy at all. But, at the very least, I’m glad we’re both gettin’ help now. If we waited any longer, we might’a ended up like Sensei.
: And I don’t know about you, Makoto, but I ain’t all that interested in a world where Ami needs to wipe drool off of my chin.
: I see...
: I am.
: Happier now, I mean.
: Or...at least, more free.
: It’s kind of crazy, actually. Like all of the weight I’ve been carrying my whole life has somehow just vanished. And I can be me now without worrying about how I’ll be in the future.
: Ain’t that kinda dangerous, though? You’ve always been worried about the future. ‘Bout where you’ll “end up” and stuff like that.
: And, now that I’m not, I can finally breathe.
: I get it, I think. Just don’t want ya losin’ sight of all that and endin’ up in a place you never wanted.
: Your situation’s different than somethin’ like that happenin’ to somebody like me who’s never really had a place they’ve wanted to go. You’ve got more to lose.
: But hey, if ‘yer happy...’yer happy. And I ain’t gonna tell ya how to live your life. Just wanted to know everythin’s okay.
: Yeah...thanks.
: Can I...ask you something, Makoto?
: Of course. Unless it’s about what you saw at the porn shop.
: It’s just...
: Are you really okay with Sensei not bein’ back yet? It really ain’t botherin’ you?
: Of course it bothers me, Miku.
: There’s just...no rush anymore.
: Better be careful, then. Not rushin’ means that somebody else might beat you to the punch.
: If that person’s me, we’ll stay friends...won’t we?
: Of course.
: That’s good...
: Cause I’ve been learnin’ more about threesomes lately and, I’ve gotta say-
: Okay, I’d like to shower in silence for the rest of the afternoon. Thanks.
One more day without you passes by.
The cogs continue to move.
